design_decisions: Both public edit paths reuse plan_chart_edits and the existing Planner. SplicePlan owns replacement fragments and borrows the original XML, validates all bounds before sorting, and validates all overlaps before exposing output chunks.
The buffered API and structural-fragment helper collect the same validated chunks. The writer API calls write_all directly on those chunks and never builds a whole-document buffer.

The writer stays borrowed and is never flushed or closed. write_all preserves standard short-write, Interrupted, and WriteZero behavior. Any I/O failure ends output immediately, with the original io::Error and custom payload preserved.

WritePatchError implements Debug, Display, and Error; source exposes the original PatchError or io::Error. PatchError gains an additive Error implementation without changes to existing variants, signatures, or public struct fields.
Malformed clone-template bounds now return the existing StructureSpanOutOfRange variant instead of indexing out of bounds; an empty template list returns SeriesNotClonable.

Integration coverage includes every ChartEdit variant, mixed edits, multiple insertions at one anchor, trait-object writers, short writes, interruption retry, untouched writers on late validation failures, typed custom I/O payload identity, exact partial prefixes, WriteZero, and direct borrowing for no-edit output.
limitations: Validation errors leave the writer untouched; I/O errors can leave an output prefix and provide no rollback guarantee.
This is isolated component validation, not an upstream contribution, full document-engine run, visual validation, or memory benchmark.
As with the existing API, callers must supply ChartData scanned from the same XML. Replacement and structural fragments remain allocated by the planner.
